plain: A man named Mike Masters, who argues that the beings people call aliens may be humans from the future, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2023 how his interest began. He says that at eight years old he had what he now understands as a moment of conscious precognition, a glimpse of something before it happened, in which he pictured a gray alien. He tells it as the starting point of his whole search, a sign that the experience reached him before he ever went looking.
